$sources: The species: Festuca rubra L., red fescue: a loosely tufted, rhizomatous perennial grass, the leaves folded, 0.5-3 mm across, the culms to 70 cm, the panicle 3-15 cm, flowering May to July (C. Stace, New Flora of the British Isles, 4th ed., Cambridge 2019, Poaceae).
The sward: the as-built meadow (windows/Source/MuseeVision/Nature/MuseeMeadow.cpp), uncut, at the north garden's density.
name: Festuca rubra
note: An uncut sward: its tufts at the species' density over the garden ground, flowering in June. The museum shows it in early summer, Mangzhong to Xiazhi (June).
